title: StyleGAN2-like conditional FFN weight modulation versus Mirror Views
hypothesis: A compact context-specific product of hidden-channel Givens rotations provides a useful non-diagonal FFN function view beyond StyleGAN2-style per-input-channel weight modulation/demodulation on rotation-dominated contexts, while using less actual serialized state than independent context FFNs.
physical_object: One shared 32x32 FFN output projection W and one common frozen 32D nonlinear feature block.
mirror_coordinate: 16 fixed adjacent-pair Givens angles per context/target family (16 FP16 coordinates). Apply h→R(m)h before the shared W.
logical_multiplicity: 40 context-specific effective FFNs: 8 contexts × five target-mixture alpha points, all sharing the same physical feature block and W.
controls: StyleGAN2 modulate/demodulate W by per-input-channel scale (32 coordinates/task)
rank-one context matrix residual over W
independent full 32x32 affine matrix per task as upper control

task.alpha_definition: alpha=1 target exactly uses StyleGAN2 weight modulation/demodulation; alpha=0 target exactly uses W@R(m); intermediate effective matrices linearly mix these two endpoint target functions.
task.feature: Frozen shared 32D ReLU MLP features; targets are linear effective-FFN outputs.
task.input_split: Independent randomly generated train and heldout inputs; all methods use the same seed-specific arrays.

development.selection_metric: mean held-out normalized RMSE per alpha; report endpoints and all mixtures separately.

storage.format: deterministic compressed NPZ with FP16 shared and task tensors plus UTF-8 metadata

compute.benchmark: eager single-thread CPU; 10 warmup and 25 timed calls on 512 feature vectors; measure modulation plus FFN projection; include modulation/generator ops.

success_gate: At alpha=0 in both development seeds, Mirror NRMSE <=0.02, <=0.10x StyleGAN2 modulation NRMSE; serialized bytes <=0.95x StyleGAN2 payload and <=0.10x independent upper payload; throughput >=0.80x StyleGAN2. Must also report alpha=1 to show native StyleGAN2 behavior; passing only opens fresh confirmation.
failure_gate: FAIL if any alpha=0 development gate is missed in either seed, or if Mirror fails to provide lower NRMSE than StyleGAN2 at comparable or lower total bytes in the rotation-target endpoint.
boundaries: Synthetic mechanism task only; not language-model NLL or natural Transformer quality.
Alpha endpoints deliberately isolate known diagonal modulation from non-diagonal rotation geometry.
An alpha=0 win is only evidence on this aligned rotation family, not arbitrary FFN capacity.
Fresh remains sealed unless both development seeds pass the complete gate.
